first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter, simpler onboarding flow because inherited evidence indicates it improves completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation—directly addressing both current declines. I would use a guarded test to confirm that higher completion translates into qualified revenue, not merely faster low-value signups. Promotional pricing may counter competitor pressure, but it risks margin and does not address the activation and onboarding deterioration.
